issues.problem: English (and gloss) say "approached among the clans" (āritaḥ); Hindi gives "honoured" (आदर पाया), a different meaning, and "जातियों" (castes) for vikṣu (clans).
anu joṣam = "according to pleasure"; "his" is supplied (Hindi adds "अपनी" too).
Same: "अपनी" is not in the text.
English and notes say "the devoted" (radhra, doubtful); "भक्त" (devotee) imports the later bhakti sense.
"their" is supplied (dhiyaḥ is only "thoughts"); the Hindi has the same "अपने".
The notes say the object of hinvānāḥ in line 2 is left unstated, but English adds the reflexive "themselves" and Hindi "अपने को". Draft contradicts its own note; the reflexive is an interpretation.

issues.problem: ariṣṭi = freedom from harm (English); अहिंसा means non-violence, a different meaning.
asme is the full Vedic dat./loc. form of asmad, not only loc.
"fairness" can read as justice or complexion; su-dina-tva is "the quality of good days". Hindi "सुन्दरता" (beauty) does not match "fairness" either. No patch: a human should pick one wording.
issues.fix: the goodness of days (Hindi: दिनों की शुभता)

summary: Reviewed 6 units. Total issues: 4 error, 8 minor (11 with machine patch). Errors: unit 3 Hindi 'आदर पाया हुआ' contradicts English 'approached' (and जातियों for clans); unit 5 English and Hindi add a reflexive object to hinvānāḥ against the draft's own note; unit 6 Hindi 'अहिंसा' for ariṣṭi. Minor: supplied possessives (his pleasure, their thoughts), भक्त in unit 4, asme label, 'fairness of days', and a self-contradicting note on the aṣāḻhāya flag in unit 2 (missing virama, not an extra a; the flag itself is right). Units 1 ok. No regrouping suggested.
